followup_explanation:
I routed to Petrel-235B because it scores meaningfully higher across the board on the relevant capability metrics — Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4), and the general reasoning/knowledge benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA). This task is a creative/philosophical composition drawing on a specific thinker's ideas, which benefits from stronger generation and knowledge capability.

The task preference dimensions didn't factor in here — both models report flat preferences on harm-adjacent content, but this query isn't distasteful or ethically fraught, so that's not relevant. The decision came down to capability, and Petrel is the stronger model with no offsetting downside (cost, latency, and context window are identical).
